zh-CN.summary: Halo 建站与博客系统，搭配 PostgreSQL。

zh-TW.summary: Halo 網站與部落格系統，搭配 PostgreSQL。

metadata.name: Halo
metadata.summary: Halo for websites and blogs, with PostgreSQL.

zh-CN.summary: Halo 应用以非 root 身份运行，套用受限配置，根文件系统只读，没有 API 令牌。PostgreSQL 由目录里的 CloudNativePG operator 管理，它的 Pod 有一个例外：一个权限受限的服务账号令牌。对外连接没有限制。

zh-TW.summary: Halo 應用程式以非 root 身分執行，套用受限設定，根檔案系統唯讀，沒有 API 權杖。PostgreSQL 由目錄裡的 CloudNativePG operator 管理，它的 Pod 有一個例外：一個權限受限的服務帳號權杖。對外連線沒有限制。

zh-CN.mitigation: 信任固定版本的目录 operator。在命名空间应用 restricted 级别的 Pod Security，并检查 operator 生成的 Pod。
zh-CN.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要使用 Kubernetes API 和一个权限受限的服务账号令牌。模板没办法直接加固 operator 生成的 Pod。

zh-TW.mitigation: 信任固定版本的目錄 operator。在命名空間套用 restricted 等級的 Pod Security，並檢查 operator 產生的 Pod。
zh-TW.risk: CloudNativePG 的 instance manager 需要使用 Kubernetes API 和一個權限受限的服務帳號權杖。範本沒辦法直接加固 operator 產生的 Pod。

risks.mitigation: Trust the pinned catalog operator. Enforce the restricted Pod Security level on the namespace, and inspect the Pods the operator generates.
risks.risk: The CloudNativePG instance manager needs the Kubernetes API and a limited service-account token. The template cannot harden the Pods that the operator creates.

zh-CN.mitigation: 第一次启动时，模板会用 halo-secrets 机密里生成的密码创建超级管理员 admin，所以没有开放的设置步骤。以 admin 登录，并在控制台修改密码。
zh-CN.risk: 如果 Halo 还没完成初始化，第一个来的访客就能创建管理员账号。

zh-TW.mitigation: 第一次啟動時，範本會用 halo-secrets 機密裡產生的密碼建立超級管理員 admin，所以沒有開放的設定步驟。以 admin 登入，並在控制台修改密碼。
zh-TW.risk: 如果 Halo 還沒完成初始化，第一個來的訪客就能建立管理員帳號。

risks.mitigation: At the first start, the template creates the super administrator admin with a generated password from the Secret halo-secrets, so there is no open setup step. Sign in as admin and change the password in the console.
risks.risk: If Halo has not been set up yet, the first visitor can create the administrator account.

zh-CN.mitigation: 除了数据库，也要把 Halo 的 PVC 备份到节点之外的地方，并测试两者一起恢复。Halo 内置的备份同样只存在节点上。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库备份不包含 Halo 的本地附件、插件和主题。

zh-TW.mitigation: 除了資料庫，也要把 Halo 的 PVC 備份到節點以外的地方，並測試兩者一起還原。Halo 內建的備份同樣只存在節點上。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫備份不包含 Halo 的本機附件、外掛和主題。

risks.mitigation: Back up the Halo PVC off the node as well as the database, and test a restore of both together. The built-in Halo backup also stays on the node.
risks.risk: Database backups do not include Halo's local attachments, plugins or themes.

security.summary: The Halo app runs as non-root with a restricted profile, a read-only root filesystem and no API token. The catalog CloudNativePG operator manages PostgreSQL, and its pods have one exception: a limited service-account token. Outbound traffic is not limited.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: halo-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: halo
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: halo
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: halo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: halo
        app.kubernetes.io/name: halo
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: halo
        image: halohub/halo:2.27.3@sha256:94ca6f3446383217d9a5a2bbed1d41a255330ba57d03ac4d0273736357ff501d
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8090
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 250m
            memory: 512Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '2'
            memory: 2Gi
        env:
        - name: HALO_WORK_DIR
          value: /var/lib/halo
        - name: SPRING_CONFIG_LOCATION
          value: optional:classpath:/;optional:file:/var/lib/halo/
        - name: HALO_EXTERNAL_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: SPRING_R2DBC_URL
          value: r2dbc:pool:postgresql://halo-db-rw:5432/halo
        - name: SPRING_SQL_INIT_PLATFORM
          value: postgresql
        - name: HALO_SECURITY_INITIALIZER_SUPERADMINUSERNAME
          value: admin
        - name: HALO_SECURITY_INITIALIZER_SUPERADMINPASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: halo-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: JVM_OPTS
          value: -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=70 -Djava.io.tmpdir=/tmp
        - name: SPRING_R2DBC_USERNAME
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: halo-db-app
              key: username
        - name: SPRING_R2DBC_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: halo-db-app
              key: password
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/halo
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/liveness
            port: http
          failureThreshold: 120
          periodSeconds: 5
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/readiness
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /actuator/health/liveness
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: halo-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 512Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: halo
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: halo
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8090
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: halo
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: halo-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: halo
            port:
              number: 8090
---
apiVersion: postgresql.cnpg.io/v1
kind: Cluster
metadata:
  name: halo-db
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  inheritedMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: halo
  instances: 1
  imageName: ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/postgresql:16-minimal-trixie@sha256:fc189febbe8c683dcf7399b93d25af3ad7a4d74c061875db300c41f0ad85f77a
  enableSuperuserAccess: false
  enablePDB: true
  postgresUID: 26
  postgresGID: 26
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
  bootstrap:
    initdb:
      database: halo
      owner: halo
      encoding: UTF8
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: '2'
      memory: 1Gi
  postgresql:
    parameters:
      shared_buffers: 128MB
      max_connections: '100'
